raw._note: GPT-6 Astra system card sec. 10.1.2.3: same 869 challenges, same intended-vulnerability agent judge. No wall-clock cap; budgeted by output tokens, but the cap's value is never stated (rate-vs-token curves are figures only), so no run-condition note is shown. Run on the v1 implementation with runtime package installation disabled and the environment offline. on_target derived as the published per-attempt rate x 869. The rates are peak values: the appendix calls 30.3% GPT-5.6 Sol's 'maximum success rate', and this board measures that model at 293/869 = 33.7%, so treat these as approximate.

Run on the v1 implementation with runtime package installation disabled and the environment offline. on_target derived as the published per-attempt rate x 869. The rates are peak values: the appendix calls 30.3% GPT-5.6 Sol's 'maximum success rate', and this board measures that model at 293/869 = 33.7%, so treat these as approximate.
